lines.1: 「Miss Kiriya, you drew the Emperor, the World, and the Magician, all upright.」
lines.2: 「Ooh, that's a good result, right? Figures.」
lines.3: 「The Princess always draws the best cards.」
lines.4: 「Forget the fortune. I'm just pleased I drew cards called the Emperor and the World.」
lines.6: 「They have such a nice ring to them, don't they? The Emperor. The World.」
lines.7: 「All right, I'm doing it too! Hit me!」
lines.8: 「Then let us begin. Please choose your cards.」
lines.9: 「Whoa, what's this? The Devil? Death? The Tower? These pictures look awesome!」
lines.11: 「Wait, really, Inori? What am I supposed to do?」
lines.12: 「Buy this spiritually potent marble, and you will be saved, Crab.」
lines.14: 「H-How much?! I can scrape together up to 250 yen!」
lines.15: 「Crabby, you have a job and you're still broke.」
lines.16: 「That's because she keeps blowing money on all that death merch.」
lines.17: Ms. Inori's fortunes were as popular as ever.
lines.18: She was close enough to our age that a lot of students treated her like a friend.
lines.19: Everyone was enjoying a perfectly ordinary school life.
lines.20: All right. Time for me to enjoy mine too.
